items.title: Mountain Pose (Tadasana)
items.description: Stand tall with feet together, arms at sides. Ground through your feet and lengthen through the crown of your head.

items.title: Downward Dog (Adho Mukha Svanasana)
items.description: Form an inverted V-shape with your body, hands and feet on the ground, hips lifted high.

items.title: Tree Pose (Vrksasana)
items.description: Balance on one leg with the other foot placed on inner thigh, hands in prayer position or overhead.

items.title: Warrior I (Virabhadrasana I)
items.description: Lunge position with front knee bent, back leg straight, arms extended overhead.
benefits: Builds strength in legs and core

items.title: Child's Pose (Balasana)
items.description: Kneel and sit back on heels, fold forward with arms extended, forehead resting on the ground.
benefits: Calms the mind and relieves stress

items.title: Cobra Pose (Bhujangasana)
items.description: Lie face down, press through hands to lift chest, keeping hips on the ground.

items.title: Warrior II (Virabhadrasana II)
items.description: Wide-legged stance with front knee bent over ankle, arms extended parallel to the floor, gaze over front hand.

items.title: Warrior III (Virabhadrasana III)
items.description: Balance on one leg while torso and raised leg form a horizontal T-shape, arms extended forward or at sides.

items.title: Triangle Pose (Trikonasana)
items.description: Wide-legged stance, reach one hand down to shin or floor and the other arm straight up, forming a triangle with the body.

items.title: Half Moon Pose (Ardha Chandrasana)
items.description: Balance on one hand and one foot, body parallel to the floor, top arm and leg extended upward.

items.title: Chair Pose (Utkatasana)
items.description: Bend knees as if sitting in an invisible chair, arms raised overhead, weight in heels.

items.title: Butterfly Pose (Baddha Konasana)
items.description: Sit with soles of feet pressed together and knees falling out to sides, gently fluttering knees up and down.

items.title: Camel Pose (Ustrasana)
items.description: Kneel upright and arch backward, hands reaching for heels, chest lifted toward the ceiling.
benefits: Deeply opens the chest and hip flexors

items.title: Bridge Pose (Setu Bandhasana)
items.description: Lie on back, bend knees with feet flat on floor, lift hips toward ceiling while clasping hands beneath body.

items.title: Boat Pose (Navasana)
items.description: Balance on sitting bones with legs extended at 45 degrees and arms parallel to the floor, forming a V-shape.
benefits: Deeply strengthens core and hip flexors

items.title: Pigeon Pose (Eka Pada Rajakapotasana)
items.description: From downward dog, bring one knee forward behind wrist, extend back leg straight, fold forward over front shin.
benefits: Deeply releases hip flexors and rotators

items.title: Seated Forward Fold (Paschimottanasana)
items.description: Sit with legs extended, hinge at hips to fold forward, reaching hands toward feet while keeping spine long.

items.title: Seated Spinal Twist (Ardha Matsyendrasana)
items.description: Sit with one leg extended, cross opposite foot over knee, twist torso toward raised knee with elbow as leverage.
benefits: Detoxifies organs through compression and release

items.title: Eagle Pose (Garudasana)
items.description: Balance on one leg, wrap opposite leg around standing leg, and cross arms at elbows with forearms intertwined.

items.title: Wheel Pose (Urdhva Dhanurasana)
items.description: Lie on back, plant hands beside ears and feet flat on floor, press up into a full backbend arch.
benefits: Strengthens arms, wrists, legs, and spine

items.title: Headstand (Sirsasana)
items.description: Interlace fingers on the floor, place crown of head between hands, walk feet in and lift legs straight overhead.
benefits: Reverses blood flow to refresh circulation

items.title: Shoulder Stand (Sarvangasana)
items.description: Lie on back and lift legs and hips straight up, supporting lower back with hands, chin tucked to chest.

items.title: Crow Pose (Bakasana)
items.description: Squat and plant hands shoulder-width apart, place knees on backs of upper arms, lean forward to balance on hands.

items.title: Upward Facing Dog (Urdhva Mukha Svanasana)
items.description: Lie face down, press through palms to lift chest and thighs fully off the ground, shoulders over wrists.

items.title: Corpse Pose (Savasana)
items.description: Lie flat on back, legs slightly apart, arms at sides with palms up, eyes closed in total relaxation.
benefits: Integrates the benefits of the practice

items.title: 1. Commencing Form
items.description: Begin with feet together, arms hanging naturally. Slowly raise arms to shoulder height, then lower while bending knees.
benefits: Calms the mind and centers energy

items.title: 2. Part the Wild Horse's Mane
items.description: Step with alternating legs while moving arms in a circular motion, as if parting a horse's mane.

items.title: 3. White Crane Spreads Wings
items.description: Shift weight to one leg while raising opposite arm high and lowering the other, mimicking a crane.

items.title: 4. Brush Knee and Twist Step
items.description: Step forward while brushing hand past knee in a circular motion and pushing opposite palm forward.

items.title: 5. Playing the Pipa
items.description: Shift weight back while bringing hands together in front of body, like holding a Chinese lute.

items.title: 6. Reverse Reeling Forearm
items.description: Step back while circling arms in a rolling motion, alternating sides.

items.title: 7. Left Grasp Bird's Tail
items.description: Circular movement incorporating ward off, roll back, press, and push on the left side.

items.title: 8. Right Grasp Bird's Tail
items.description: Same as movement 7, performed on the right side.

items.title: 9. Single Whip
items.description: Extend one arm out as a 'hook' hand while the other palm pushes forward, stepping wide into a bow stance.

items.title: 10. Wave Hands Like Clouds
items.description: Shift weight side to side while hands move in slow, overlapping horizontal circles at chest and waist height.

items.title: 11. Single Whip (Repeat)
items.description: Repeat of Single Whip, consolidating the technique on both sides from Cloud Hands transition.

items.title: 12. High Pat on Horse
items.description: Shift weight back while one hand sweeps down and the other rises to press forward at face height, as if patting a tall horse.

items.title: 13. Right Heel Kick
items.description: Bring hands together in front of chest, then separate them outward while kicking with the right heel.

items.title: 14. Strike Opponent's Ears with Fists
items.description: Drop into bow stance while both fists arc inward to strike simultaneously at ear level.

items.title: 15. Left Heel Kick
items.description: Mirror of movement 13 — hands come together then separate as the left heel kicks outward.

items.title: 16. Snake Creeps Down / Golden Cock Stands on Left Leg
items.description: Sink deeply into a low squat along one leg while the other extends, then rise into a single-leg stand with knee raised.
benefits: Builds deep leg and hip strength

items.title: 17. Golden Cock Stands on Right Leg
items.description: Repeat of the Snake Creeps Down transition, rising into a single-leg stand on the right side.

items.title: 18. Fair Lady Works Shuttles (Left & Right)
items.description: Alternating diagonal steps with one arm raised overhead to block and the other pushing forward, performed on four corners.

items.title: 19. Needle at Sea Bottom
items.description: Shift weight back and dip forward with one hand pointing straight down toward the ground, like threading a needle into the sea.

items.title: 20. Flash the Back
items.description: Rise from needle posture, step forward, and raise both arms — one overhead and one to the side — in an expansive open posture.
benefits: Transitions power from low to high

items.title: 21. Turn, Deflect, Parry and Punch
items.description: Pivot to turn around, deflect an incoming strike, parry with one arm, then deliver a straight punch.

items.title: 22. Apparent Close-Up
items.description: Withdraw both hands under the extended arm, then push both palms forward explosively into a bow stance.

items.title: 23. Cross Hands
items.description: Step to shoulder width while crossing both wrists in front of the chest, then open slightly in a calm, centered posture.
benefits: Returns to a centered, balanced state

items.title: 24. Closing Form
items.description: Lower arms slowly to sides while straightening the legs, returning to the natural standing posture of the commencing form.

items.title: Guided Meditation
items.description: Follow a teacher's voice through visualization, body scans, or relaxation sequences. Ideal for beginners who benefit from external direction.

items.title: DMT Breathing (Holotropic)
items.description: Rapid, rhythmic breathing sustained for 20–30 minutes to alter brain chemistry and induce non-ordinary states of consciousness.

items.title: Wim Hof Method
items.description: 30–40 deep power breaths followed by a breath retention on empty lungs, then a recovery breath held for 15 seconds. Repeat 3–4 rounds.

items.title: Breath of Fire (Kapalabhati)
items.description: Rapid, rhythmic pumping exhales through the nose driven by sharp abdominal contractions, with passive inhales. Sustained for 1–3 minutes.

items.title: Box Breathing (Sama Vritti)
items.description: Inhale for 4 counts, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold for 4. Repeat for 4–8 cycles. Used by Navy SEALs and athletes for stress regulation.

items.title: Alternate Nostril Breathing (Nadi Shodhana)
items.description: Use the thumb and ring finger to alternate closing each nostril, breathing in one side and out the other in a continuous cycle.
benefits: Balances left and right brain hemispheres
Lowers heart rate and blood pressure

items.title: Ocean Breath (Ujjayi)
items.description: Slightly constrict the back of the throat while breathing through the nose, creating an audible ocean-wave sound on both inhale and exhale.
benefits: Anchors attention during yoga or movement

items.title: Sitali Cooling Breath
items.description: Roll the tongue into a tube and inhale through it like a straw, then close the mouth and exhale slowly through the nose.
benefits: Cools the body in heat or fever

items.title: Humming Bee Breath (Bhramari)
items.description: Close ears with thumbs and eyes with fingers, then hum on the exhale like a bee, creating internal resonance throughout the skull.

items.title: Mindfulness Meditation (Vipassana)
items.description: Sit still and observe the breath, bodily sensations, thoughts, and emotions with complete non-judgmental awareness as they arise and pass.

items.title: Loving-Kindness Meditation (Metta)
items.description: Silently repeat phrases of goodwill — 'May I be happy, may I be safe' — first toward yourself, then expanding outward to others and all beings.

items.title: Candle Gazing (Trataka)
items.description: Fix your unblinking gaze on a candle flame for 5–15 minutes. When eyes water, close them and visualize the flame between the eyebrows.

items.title: 4-7-8 Breathing
items.description: Inhale quietly through the nose for 4 counts, hold for 7, then exhale completely through the mouth for 8 counts. Repeat 4 cycles.

items.title: Transcendental Meditation (TM)
items.description: Silently repeat a personal mantra for 20 minutes twice daily, allowing the mind to settle into a state of restful alertness beyond thought.
benefits: Produces deep rest deeper than sleep

items.title: Body Scan Meditation
items.description: Lie down and slowly move awareness through each region of the body from toes to crown, observing sensations without trying to change them.
benefits: Releases physical tension and holding patterns

items.title: Kundalini Meditation
items.description: Combines specific breath patterns, mudras, mantras, and eye positions in timed sequences to awaken latent energy at the base of the spine.

items.title: Walking Meditation (Kinhin)
items.description: Walk at an extremely slow pace, synchronizing each small step with the breath and maintaining full attention on the sensation of movement.
benefits: Accessible for those unable to sit still

items.title: Sound Bath / Nada Yoga
items.description: Immerse in sustained tones from singing bowls, gongs, or drones. Breathe slowly and allow the vibrations to dissolve mental chatter.
benefits: Deeply relaxes the nervous system via sound resonance

items.title: Yoga Nidra (Yogic Sleep)
items.description: Lie in savasana and follow guided prompts through the hypnagogic state between waking and sleep, maintaining a thread of conscious awareness.
benefits: One hour equals four hours of sleep in restoration

items.title: Coherent Breathing (5-5)
items.description: Breathe in for exactly 5 seconds and out for exactly 5 seconds — roughly 6 breaths per minute — the optimal rate for heart rate variability.

items.title: Zen Sitting (Zazen)
items.description: Sit in precise posture on a zafu, eyes half-open downward, simply allowing thoughts to arise and dissolve without engagement — just sitting.
benefits: Dissolves the boundary between meditator and meditation

items.title: Bellows Breath (Bhastrika)
items.description: Forceful, rapid inhales AND exhales through the nose driven by full chest and belly expansion, like a blacksmith's bellows. Done in rounds of 20.
benefits: Clears stagnant energy from the lungs

items.title: Full Moon / Open Awareness Meditation
items.description: Sit under the open sky or by a window and let awareness expand in all directions simultaneously, like the light of the full moon — receiving everything, grasping nothing.
benefits: Dissolves the sense of a bounded self

items.title: Tummo Inner Fire Meditation
items.description: Tibetan tantric practice combining breath retentions, visualizations of inner flame at the navel, and body locks (bandhas) to generate intense internal heat.
benefits: Foundation of all Tibetan completion-stage practices

items.title: Breath Awareness (Anapanasati)
items.description: The original breath meditation taught by the Buddha — simply observe the natural breath at the nostrils, noticing each inhale, exhale, and the pauses between.
benefits: Foundational path to liberation in Buddhist tradition

items.title: Bear Crawl
items.description: Quadrupedal movement with hips high, opposite hand and foot advancing together. Keep arms and legs straight, core braced, and move with rhythm.

items.title: Lizard Crawl
items.description: Stay low to the ground with chest and belly nearly touching the floor. Move with ipsilateral coordination — same-side hand and foot advance together.

items.title: Crab Walk
items.description: Face up with hands behind you and feet flat on the floor. Lift hips high and walk forwards, backwards, or laterally with controlled steps.
benefits: Improves shoulder extension and wrist strength

items.title: Ape Reach
items.description: From a deep squat, shift laterally by reaching one hand to the ground while the other sweeps overhead. Travel side to side with fluid transitions.
benefits: Deep squat mobility and lateral movement

items.title: Frog Jump
items.description: From a deep squat with hands on the ground, explosively jump forward, extending fully before landing softly back into squat.
benefits: Hip and ankle mobility under load

items.title: Panther Crawl
items.description: Hands and feet on the ground with knees hovering just an inch off the floor. Move slowly and silently with contralateral limb coordination.

items.title: Scorpion Reach
items.description: From a prone push-up position, thread one leg under your body and across while rotating the hips, reaching the foot toward the opposite hand.

items.title: Gorilla Shuffle
items.description: Hinge at the hips, plant both hands on the ground, then hop both feet forward or laterally. Repeat with alternating hand placement.

items.title: Spider Crawl
items.description: From a deep push-up position, bring one knee wide toward the same-side elbow as you advance the opposite hand, creating a sprawling spider-like gait.

items.title: Snake Roll
items.description: Lie on the ground and use undulating spinal waves to roll and travel, initiating movement from the hips or shoulders without using hands or feet.
benefits: Develops body wave and flow mechanics

items.title: Turtle Roll
items.description: Curl into a tight ball on your back (shell position), then use momentum and core control to roll onto your front and back again without using hands.

items.title: Lion Stretch
items.description: From a low lunge position, sink hips deep and extend arms forward along the ground like a lion stretching after rest, then push up into an arching backbend.
benefits: Hip flexor and thoracic extension stretch

items.title: Octopus Roll
items.description: From seated, roll to one side using fluid, circular limb movements, transitioning through positions while keeping constant multi-directional motion.

items.title: Kangaroo Bound
items.description: From standing, drop into a squat and perform consecutive broad jumps with powerful hip extension, swinging arms for momentum.
benefits: Hip and knee joint loading capacity

items.title: Flamingo Stand
items.description: Balance on one leg with eyes closed while performing slow, controlled arm and free-leg movements in all three planes of motion.

items.title: Dragon Twist
items.description: From a deep lunge, rotate your torso toward the front leg, reaching the top arm skyward. Flow between sides in a continuous, spiraling pattern.
benefits: Deep hip flexor and hamstring stretch

items.title: Inchworm Walk
items.description: From standing, fold forward and walk hands out to a push-up position, then walk feet toward hands. Repeat in a continuous wave-like motion.

items.title: Horse Stance Walk
items.description: Hold a wide, low horse stance and walk laterally with controlled steps, keeping hips level and thighs parallel to the ground.

items.title: Shark Roll
items.description: From a prone position, initiate a powerful lateral roll using a full body wave, transitioning seamlessly between prone and supine.

items.title: Chameleon Reach
items.description: From a low squat, slowly extend one leg behind while reaching the opposite arm far forward, holding the end position with stillness and control.

items.title: Bull Rush
items.description: From a bent-over position, drive forward explosively with short, powerful steps, hands near the ground, simulating a charging motion.
